extension.summary: Custom collections mixing movies and TV shows.
Colecciones personalizadas que mezclan películas y series.
extension.description: Create your own collections (e.g. "Marvel Cinematic Universe") that mix movies and TV shows from your library, in the order you choose.
Crea tus propias colecciones (p. ej. "Universo Cinematográfico de Marvel") que mezclan películas y series de tu biblioteca, en el orden que elijas.
extension.news:
v0.1.1 (2026-05-09) - Add changelog metadata so Kodi shows release notes in the install dialog.
v0.1.0 (2026-05-09) - Initial release. - Create, rename and delete collections that mix movies and TV shows. - Add items via the global context menu on any movie or TV show. - Reorder items inside a collection (move up / move down). - Cached metadata so collections render instantly even on shared MariaDB libraries. - Refresh metadata per item or per collection from the context menu. - English and Spanish translations.
